faq_heading: Homes near Bonaccord Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Bonaccord Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Bonaccord Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Bonaccord Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Bonaccord Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Mountainview Montessori (0.5 km east), Johnston Heights Secondary (0.8 km east) and Berkshire Park Elementary (1.1 km south-east).

How the Bonaccord Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Bonaccord Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Bonaccord Elementary

36 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Bonaccord Elementary in a straight line (22 elementary, 13 secondary, 1 other; 5 independent). The closest is Mountainview Montessori, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Johnston Heights Secondary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Our Lady of Good Counsel (2.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is North Surrey Secondary (2.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: Mountainview Montessori (0.5 km east), Berkshire Park Elementary (1.1 km south-east), William F. Davidson Elementary (1.2 km east), Hjorth Road Elementary (1.3 km north), Lena Shaw Elementary (1.6 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Mountainview Montessori, 0.5 km east of Bonaccord Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Bonaccord Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Bonaccord Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Bonaccord Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Mountainview Montessori, the nearest other elementary school, 0.5 km east of Bonaccord Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
